主要内容: On March 20, 2014, Sangamo BioSciences, Inc. entered into an underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, enabling the issuance and sale of 4,444,444 shares of common stock in an underwritten public offering. The shares were sold at $22.50 per share, with the Company estimating net proceeds of approximately $93.8 million after underwriting discounts and offering expenses. The Underwriters were granted an option to purchase up to 666,666 additional shares. The Offering was conducted under the Company’s effective registration statement on Form S-3ASR and supplemented by a final prospectus dated March 20, 2014. The Company issued a press release announcing the pricing of the Offering on the same date.
